title: AI Patent Drafting Masterclass: FICPI Budapest Recap
summary: Over 90 patent attorneys compared three AI drafting platforms at FICPI’s Budapest masterclass. See the four lessons and how to host a similar session.
body_markdown:
Over 90 patent attorneys compared three AI drafting platforms on the same invention disclosure at FICPI’s Budapest masterclass. Four lessons emerged: hands-on practice builds confidence, workflow fit matters, specialist fields need specialist tools, and attorneys want control of review. Solve Intelligence can run similar vendor-neutral sessions for associations and firms.


### Key takeaways


- FICPI’s vendor-neutral format had over 90 delegates draft on three AI platforms from one invention disclosure, grouped by experience and technology.
- Chemistry and biotech delegates tested genus claims, chemical structures and ST.26 sequence listings, which need tools that handle structures and sequences directly.
- Delegates asked most about review: track changes, visible AI reasoning, editable analyses and traceable comments that keep the attorney in control.


In September 2026, FICPI held its[AI Patent Drafting Masterclass](https://ficpi.org/ficpi-ai-patent-drafting-masterclass-2026) in Budapest, immediately before the 23rd Open Forum. Solve Intelligence was proud to be one of the three platforms delegates put to the test.


Every delegate had trial access to[Solve Intelligence](https://www.solveintelligence.com/) , Ankar and DeepIP, and judged the workflows, outputs and limitations for themselves. There were no sales pitches, just practitioners doing the work and seeing what holds up.


Our thanks go to Julian Crump and the FICPI organising committee for building a programme this rigorous, and to every delegate who gave up a day before the Open Forum to roll up their sleeves and test AI solutions.


## **What the masterclass involved**


The masterclass started weeks before anyone arrived in Budapest.


### **Pre-work: onboarding and disclosure**


Weeks before the class, delegates were onboarded and received a common exercise pack: a "Brakes for Cranes" invention disclosure with drawings, a drafting template and a short instruction sheet. In each platform they set up a project, uploaded the same materials and generated a claim set.


We walked through project setup, uploading and analysing disclosures, our recommended drafting workflow, prior-art search from chat,[figure generation](https://www.solveintelligence.com/blog/post/ai-for-patent-drawings-figure-generation-and-labeling) , and our[chemistry and sequence-listing tools](https://www.solveintelligence.com/solutions/life-sciences) . Recordings went out to everyone afterwards.


### **Masterclass**


The day itself was built around small, hands-on groups.


- **Morning:** delegates stayed with the Brakes for Cranes example, grouped by experience level
- **Afternoon:** delegates split into technology rooms: chemistry, biotechnology, mechanical/electromechanical, and ICT
- **Two levels per exercise:** beginners and intermediates amended a near-complete application to add a new feature; advanced users drafted from scratch off an invention disclosure. Extra examples with client instructions were handed out on the day.
- **Small groups, close support:** sessions of 30 delegates, with roughly one tutor for every ten people


Every delegate worked in their own account, following along live. Our tutors were Harry Bedford (UK and EP patent attorney), Chantal Powel (UK and EP patent attorney) and Barrett Cole (US attorney), all of whom have drafted and prosecuted patents in private practice.


## **Lessons learned**


A day of side-by-side drafting surfaces things a demo never does. Four lessons stood out.


- **Hands-on practice beats a slide deck**


- Delegates learned most when they were drafting in their own accounts, within their own technology area, with a tutor close by. Seeing an output against a disclosure you have read yourself is what builds real confidence in a tool.


- **Workflow matters as much as output**


- It’s important to find a tool that works well with your current workflow. Delegates were able to see the real value in working with a platform that is intuitive and purpose-built for patent workflows.


- **Specialist fields need specialist tools**


- The chemistry and biotech rooms put workflows centered on genus claims, chemical structures and ST.26 sequence listings to the test. Practitioners in those fields need tools that handle structures and sequences well, and our chemical structure and sequence listing flows were a highlight for many practitioners.


- **The attorney stays in control**


- The questions we heard most were about review: track changes, visible AI reasoning, editable analyses, and traceable comments. Practitioners want AI that allows for a deeper and more efficient draft, while still keeping the practitioner in full control of the AI and its review functionalities.


We also came away with a long list of new product feedback. We absolutely love working with our customers, both in-person and online. Everything you see in the Solve Intelligence platform is because it’s been requested, so thank you to all of the Masterclass participants for your fantastic ideas.


> "Everyone in the feedback round agreed that Solve Intelligence was the most complex and potent tool of the three." – Delegate, FICPI AI Masterclass


## **Bring a masterclass to your organization**


Budapest showed us that practitioners want to test AI drafting tools rigorously and with their own materials.


We're keen to partner with IP associations, conferences and firms to host hands-on AI drafting masterclasses, whether as a full-day workshop or a shorter session.


Earlier this year we hosted an online masterclass with IPWatchdog. Read our reflections on the masterclass on AI prompt engineering for patent workflows. We're glad to run them in a vendor-neutral, head-to-head format like FICPI's, where delegates compare platforms on the same material. A typical session includes:


- Trial access and a pre-work pack so delegates arrive ready to draft
- Live onboarding webinars, recorded for anyone who can't attend
- Technology-specific exercises in chemistry, biotech, mechanical and ICT, set at beginner and advanced levels
- Small groups led by qualified patent attorneys from our team


If you'd like to host a masterclass for your members or your firm,[get in touch with our team](https://www.solveintelligence.com/) . We'd love to hear from you.
